title: UAAP: For Alas and Bahay, leadership by example is key to Ateneo's continued growth
summary: Fast-tracking Ateneo de Manila University’s maturity remains one of head coach Louie Alas’ priorities, and star guards Jared Bahay and Kieffer Alas have been leading the way for the Blue Eagles.
